game.name: Ninja Gaiden II (World)(Beta)(2008-03-20)
game.desc: Ninja Gaiden II on Xbox 360 brings back the famous ninja Ryu Hayabusa in an uncompromising action game. Extremely violent, as well as difficult, the hero's quest to defeat demons released by a clan of evil ninjas takes him to the four corners of the world. By linking combos and magical attacks with great dexterity, he will have to send these destructive beings and their demonic legions back to their dimension.
